item.title: Photographs of drama and emotion – the career of Chris Smith
item.summary: The late photographer has left behind memorable images of many of the larger-than-life characters who peopled the last four decades of the 20th century: Muhammad Ali, Paul Gascoigne, John McEnroe, Martina Navratilova, Aretha Franklin, Seve Ballesteros and Daley Thompson Chris Smith obituary Continue reading...
